Index.meta_title: Alizé Residence | Luxury Beachfront Apartments & Condominiums in Da Nang
Index.meta_description: Discover Alizé Residence Da Nang. Exclusive luxury beachfront condominiums and penthouses on My Khe Beach, designed by AEDAS, developed by A&T Group.
Index.trade_wind_story: Trade Winds once guided legendary voyages across the ocean. Today, they return to the shores of My Khe, blending with the city's pulse. Alizé invites you to an artistic journey: returning home to your own private sanctuary.
Index.stone_desc: Natural stone façades were selected for their timeless appearance, durability and ease of maintenance, allowing the architecture to age beautifully over time.
Index.three_reasons: A SERENE COMPOSITION BY MY KHE BEACH
Index.real_life_location: “The art of a refined life is sometimes simply possessing a sanctuary quiet enough to listen to oneself.”
Index.location_heading: A PRIVATE SANCTUARY AMIDST THE PULSE OF THE OCEAN
Index.location_desc_1: Nestled at the prestigious intersection of Vo Nguyen Giap and Vo Van Kiet, Alizé emerges along the shores of My Khe as an exclusive private condominium haven. Here, natural ocean breezes carry the crisp scent of the sea and the invigorating vitality of Da Nang.
Index.location_desc_2: Touch the vibrant pulse of the city in a single step. Behold the endless horizon with a glance. From Alizé, journeys to the airport, downtown, and historic heritage lands unfold effortlessly.
Index.pool_quote: Instead of corridors, walking paths connect the apartments — making Alize Residence feel closer to a group of private homes than a standard...
Index.pool_quote_desc: An artistic icon shaping the spatial essence of Da Nang
Index.concept_desc: “From the invisible dances of the wind, AEDAS weaves a tangible language — where each architectural contour sings its own rhythm between the sea and sky of My Khe.”
Index.between_marbella: THE EPICENTER OF MY KHE BEACHFRONT
Index.between_marbella_desc: Positioned on the prestigious Vo Nguyen Giap coastal boulevard, directly overlooking the world-renowned My Khe Beach. Alizé offers effortless connectivity to Da Nang downtown, Son Tra Peninsula, and Hoi An Ancient Town, crafting a world-class resort lifestyle.
Index.this_year: A privileged sanctuary cherished amidst the winds
Index.timeline_love_bridge_desc: A romantic rendezvous along the poetic Han River adorned with love locks and the Carp-Dragon statue, offering panoramic sunset and festival firework views.
Index.timeline_admin_center_desc: The iconic lotus-shaped architectural tower rising above the urban skyline, connecting seamlessly to major administrative, financial, and diplomatic hubs.
Index.timeline_cham_museum_desc: The world's largest repository of antique Champa art, harmoniously blending French colonial charm with millennium-old mystical sandstone relics.
Index.timeline_marble_mountains_desc: A legendary ensemble of five limestone peaks rising from coastal plains, celebrated for mystical grottoes, ancient pagodas, and traditional stone craftsmanship.
Index.timeline_son_tra_desc: The pristine emerald crown of Da Nang where virgin forests meet the sea, home to Linh Ung Pagoda, misty Ban Co Peak, and the rare red-shanked douc langur.
Index.timeline_hoi_an_desc: A UNESCO World Heritage jewel of moss-tinted rooftops, cascading bougainvillea, glowing lanterns along the Hoai River, and world-renowned culinary heritage.
Index.timeline_my_son_desc: A thousand-year-old Hindu sanctuary nestled in a secluded valley, showcasing the enigmatic red-brick architectural triumph of the ancient Champa civilization.
Index.a_place_to_live:
A PLACE TO LIVE — TO

RETURN YEAR AFTER YEAR
Index.residences_range: RESIDENCES RANGE FROM 104 TO 244 SQ.M., OFFERING SPACIOUS SINGLE LEVEL AND DUPLEX LAYOUTS WITH GENEROUS TERRACES AND ROOFTOP SOLARIUMS.
Index.slide_1_desc: Private basement, direct outdoor access and a dedicated lower level.
Index.slide_2_desc: Two floors crowned with panoramic views and a private rooftop solarium — the ultimate expression of luxury living.
Index.slide_3_desc: Expansive living spaces with breathtaking sea views and unparalleled comfort.
Index.seventh_quote_1: INSTEAD OF CORRIDORS, WALKING PATHS CONNECT THE APARTMENTS — MAKING ALIZE RESIDENCE FEEL CLOSER TO A GROUP OF PRIVATE HOMES THAN A STANDARD COMPLEX
Index.seventh_quote_2: DIVE INTO SERENITY. OUR INFINITY POOLS BLEND SEAMLESSLY WITH THE HORIZON, OFFERING A PERFECT OASIS FOR RELAXATION AND REJUVENATION UNDER THE SUN
Index.seventh_quote_3: EACH PARKING SPACE INCLUDES PRE-INSTALLATION FOR OPTIONAL EV CHARGING.
Index.seventh_quote_4: A STATE-OF-THE-ART WELLNESS CENTER FEATURING PREMIUM EQUIPMENT AND SPA FACILITIES, DESIGNED TO NOURISH BOTH BODY AND MIND IN ABSOLUTE PRIVACY
Index.seventh_quote_5: METICULOUSLY CRAFTED MEDITERRANEAN GARDENS CREATE A LUSH, VERDANT ENVIRONMENT THAT CELEBRATES NATURE AND PROVIDES TRANQUIL SPACES FOR MEDITATION
Index.underfloor_heating: Multi-zone smart climate control, high-security digital smart lock system, triple-glazed Low-E acoustic and thermal insulating glass, and premium imported finishes from Schneider Electric and world-renowned luxury brands.
Index.architecture_split_title: Gentle curves, cascading balconies, and continuous openings sculpted by the wind, allowing Alizé to move in harmony with the ocean's breath.
Index.developer_detail: A prestigious real estate developer committed to creating iconic landmarks and enduring values for generations across Vietnam.
Index.sales_marketing_detail: Leading real estate project developer and marketer, ensuring operational excellence and premier standards for Alizé.
Index.architect_design_detail: Global top 5 architectural design consultancy, creating an artistic language of coastal winds and bespoke luxury residences.
Index.license_obtained_detail: Complete legal documentation and transparent construction permits safeguarding ownership peace of mind and long-term appreciation.
Index.year_2026_detail: Precision engineering and construction excellence, prepared to welcome distinguished homeowners into an exceptional coastal sanctuary.
Index.at_group_desc_1: Carrying the aspiration to create enduring value in Vietnam's real estate market, A&T Group has progressively developed a diverse ecosystem of projects across high-potential provinces and cities. Each development represents a dedicated investment in prime location, master planning, architecture, and craftsmanship, aimed at delivering sustainable values for communities and future generations.
Index.at_group_desc_2: Alizé stands as one of those hallmark milestones – where A&T Group infuses its pioneering spirit into an extraordinary living sanctuary along My Khe Beach, sculpted by the wind, light, and the art of architecture.
Index.address_line_1: VO NGUYEN GIAP BLVD, PHUOC MY WARD
Index.address_line_2: SON TRA DISTRICT, DA NANG CITY, VIETNAM
Index.boutique_desc: A boutique gated community of 25 residences on Costa del Sol, designed around privacy, wellbeing and timeless Mediterranean living.

PrivacyPage.meta_title: Privacy Policy | Alizé Residence Da Nang
PrivacyPage.meta_description: Personal data protection policy for Alizé Residence. Full compliance with Decree 13/2023/ND-CP regarding personal data protection, transparency, and consumer rights.
PrivacyPage.hero_subtitle: Our commitment to transparency and safeguarding your personal privacy in accordance with international criteria.
PrivacyPage.section_1_content: Alizé Residence collects necessary personal particulars (full name, phone number, email address, property preferences) solely when you voluntarily inquire, book private show-gallery viewings, or execute sale agreements. This information enables tailored advisory, regulatory compliance, and bespoke concierge hospitality.
PrivacyPage.section_2_title: 2. Scope of Use & Zero Unauthorized Sharing
PrivacyPage.section_2_content: Your information is restricted to internal usage by Developer A&T Group and Development Partner DXMD Vietnam. We strictly do not sell, lease, or disseminate your personal data to any external commercial parties beyond legitimate property transactions directly related to Alizé Residence.
PrivacyPage.section_3_content: All information is safeguarded across servers fortified with 256-bit SSL encryption and maintained in strict adherence to Decree 13/2023/ND-CP on Personal Data Protection. Data is retained until contractual obligations are fully resolved or upon official deletion requests from data subjects.
PrivacyPage.section_4_content: You retain full statutory rights to inspect, update, rectify, or request permanent erasure of your personal data at any time by contacting our Concierge Desk or transmitting an inquiry to our dedicated security email.
PrivacyPage.contact_box_desc: Inquiries or formal requests regarding privacy practices may be forwarded to: privacy@alize-residence.com or via our 24/7 Hotline: +84 (965) 355-355.

TermsPage.meta_title: Terms of Use | Alizé Residence Da Nang
TermsPage.meta_description: Terms and conditions governing the use of the official Alizé Residence Da Nang digital platform. AEDAS architectural intellectual property and legal disclaimers.
TermsPage.hero_subtitle: Statutory provisions regulating access and interaction with the official Alizé Residence digital repository.
TermsPage.section_1_content: By accessing, browsing, or interacting with the Alizé Residence platform, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and consented to be bound by these Terms of Use. If you do not agree with any terms, please discontinue platform use immediately.
TermsPage.section_2_content: All materials including AEDAS aerodynamic architectural schematics, 3D renderings, 4K cinematic recordings, marketing brochures, logos, and Alizé brand identity remain the exclusive intellectual property of A&T Group and its partners. Unauthorized reproduction, quoting, or commercial redistribution without explicit written sanction constitutes a statutory violation.
TermsPage.section_3_content: Architectural renderings, technical specifications, and imagery presented across this portal are conceptual and provided for illustrative reference. Definitive parameters and specifications are legally established solely within formal Sale & Purchase Agreements signed between counterparties pursuant to prevailing law.
TermsPage.section_4_content: These Terms are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam. Any controversies arising from platform utilization shall initially be addressed via amicable mediation; failing settlement, jurisdiction lies with competent courts in Da Nang City.
TermsPage.contact_box_desc: Legal Affairs Division: legal@alize-residence.com — Sales Gallery: Vo Nguyen Giap Blvd, Phuoc My, Son Tra, Da Nang City.

RegulationsPage.meta_title: Building Operating Regulations | Alizé Residence Da Nang
RegulationsPage.meta_description: Operating regulations and governance charter for Alizé Residence Da Nang: 5-star security protocols, rooftop infinity pool rules, fire safety, and residential standards.
RegulationsPage.hero_subtitle: Civilized property operational standards ensuring uncompromising security, tranquil luxury, and world-class communal harmony.
RegulationsPage.section_1_content: Alizé Residence operates under rigorous 5-star international hospitality governance supervised by a professional Management Operator. All owners, guests, and personnel share the mutual duty to uphold refined lifestyle standards, honor peer privacy, and protect communal assets.
RegulationsPage.section_2_content: Multi-tier security operates 24/7 incorporating public AI surveillance, encrypted floor-isolated elevator access badges, and staffed checkpoints at primary vestibules and subterranean garages. All visitors must register at the Concierge desk.
RegulationsPage.section_3_content: The 39th-floor celestial infinity pool, Sky Lounge, Spa, and fitness facilities operate under designated hours. Residents and guests must adhere to proper attire, aquatic safety guidelines, and quiet tranquility. Smoking and disruptive activities are strictly prohibited within wellness zones.
RegulationsPage.section_4_content: Storage of hazardous combustibles, obstructing fire escape corridors, or tampering with in-unit sprinkler heads and smoke detectors is strictly prohibited under statutory penalties. Scheduled drills are conducted jointly with the Da Nang Fire & Rescue Police.
